original_case_assessment.declared_method: Single-context baseline source review; no Qore invocation or independent verifier.

criteria.definition: Accurate relevant project rules and distinct focus destinations.
criteria.rationale: The final review accurately separates Close-to-summary focus from Back-to-introduction-heading focus, distinguishes the current contract's forward Tab route from the checker's broader accepted set, and identifies the Enter/Space/Enter help cycle.

criteria.definition: Sequential keyboard traversal and Enter evidence for Back; click or programmatic focus alone is insufficient.
criteria.rationale: For this document-review task, the report correctly diagnoses that a click plus destination focus is insufficient, and requires actual sequential Tab reachability, observed Back focus and Enter activation as the correction. It does not pretend it observed a browser.
criteria.uncertainty: Actual deployed Back traversal and Enter behavior remain UNKNOWN; no live evidence was requested or obtained in this offline review.

criteria.definition: Unanswered state and enforced activation, network and origin boundaries.
criteria.rationale: The review preserves unanswered state and identifies the absent enforcement/evidence for origin and allowed-method boundaries, including blocked analytics effects. Its proposed prerequisites precede future navigation. The trial itself had a recorded disabled-network/read-only-input boundary.
criteria.uncertainty: A sandbox connection denial does not establish website-side or browser request-guard behavior; actual blocked website requests and external harness configuration remain unobserved.

criteria.definition: Evidence or explicit uncertainty; never mislabel a protocol fixture result as a website defect.
criteria.rationale: Findings cite source lines, retain counterpoints and uncertainty, and explicitly identify the target as a reconstructed fixture rather than a website defect. No browser performance, focus or network success is claimed.

criteria.definition: Relevant checker command and acceptance checks for planning/review; proposed and executed commands remain distinct.
criteria.rationale: The relevant contract checker is actually recorded with command, cwd, exit 0 and complete stdout. Proposed procedure/acceptance corrections remain distinct from that executed consistency check; the report states the checker cannot validate the Markdown or website.

criteria.definition: Scoped decision supported by actual observations.
criteria.rationale: The decision is limited to three supported procedure-proof gaps plus an explicitly bounded reproducibility observation. No release, deployment or website acceptance decision is inferred.

method_assessment.phase_inventory: A single source review, actual checker result, input hashes and full line-numbered source transcript are retained. No Qore phases are required for this baseline.
method_assessment.complete_substantiated: YES, for completion of the requested offline source review only. No requirement for independent Qore verification is imposed on baseline.
limitations: No independent verifier was claimed or performed.

The source-evidence file is a line-numbered text retention, not a separate exact-byte raw source tree; its reported four project-source digests agree with the copied sources in the other authorized runs.
The enclosing prepared-input/candidate identity was supplied metadata rather than independently reconstructed.
The evaluator did not have a native full execution transcript; command execution is supported by retained records and output, not independently replayed.

limits: Neutral filenames did not blind conditions.
The raw criterion judgments concern their declared task scope; later method-coverage qualification is separate.
